# P03 node-option fixtures

[Owner contract](../../../../../docs/isos/interfaces/nodes/selectors.md) · [中文契约](../../../../../docs_cn/isos/interfaces/nodes/selectors_cn.md)

`positive-response.json` freezes `graph_revision:null` and `read_only:false` for POST plus the exact seven `(node_path,setting)` groups expected from a `0.1.0` starter after previewing the verified P02 `sim-hardware` set with scene `pick-place`. The fixture asserts only the new `data.setting_options` projection: the existing `adapter_families`, `primitive_bindings`, and `targets` collections must still be present, but their current EOS catalog contents are intentionally not copied here. All rows use the real `island/mujoco-sim@0.1.1` target descriptor's stable IDs, labels and descriptions, sorted by node path/setting/value. The input graph is the exact P02 node-set preview, with an owner-private socket path supplied by the test home; it is never a saved graph mutation or an option value.

`negative-cases.json` freezes Apply outcomes after an earlier options request, one direct link rejection, and malformed selected-ID rejection from both options and Apply. Each mutation starts from the same verified preview in a fresh home unless its `op` says it mutates the candidate descriptor before linking. The partial descriptor fails during `POST /packages/link` before any receipt or graph-time Apply; its diagnostic path is the empty string. Editing a sealed linked descriptor after an options response instead fails P01 payload verification at the graph process pin. `expected.diagnostic` contains the exact `{code,path,stage}` subset of the bounded P01/P02 diagnostic; `expected.status` is the HTTP status. `selected_*_option` freezes the synthetic unavailable row subset returned by a subsequent options request. The stale revision case has no admission diagnostic because the saved revision check returns the established 409 error. `compatibility-cases.json` freezes exact GET revision correlation against the existing saved legacy fixture, the GET graph/options race, unknown graph version and type paths, a test-injected invalid selector declaration, and an uncompiled EOS adapter reason. The injected catalog variants are unit/HTTP test inputs, never edits to a sealed package sidecar. Every negative case asserts unchanged saved graph bytes and revision, active revision and children. The scenario with an absent `0.1.2` package demonstrates P01 missing-pin precedence over P02 adapter matching. A second **verified** but different adapter pin exercises P02 `mujoco_device_unavailable` at the generic adapter pointer. The scene-ineligible case uses a valid, newly sealed descriptor variant whose arm is declared only for `pick-place`.

Implementation replay: build EOS, IsOS and the real MuJoCo bundle, link the exact release in a fresh `ISOS_HOME`, preview the set, request POST options, and compare the `setting_options` projection to `positive-response.json`. Repeat with GET after Apply and confirm identical rows. Apply each graph-time negative mutation with the current revision, and run the direct partial-descriptor case through package link; inspect the exact diagnostic and byte/status invariants, then retry with an updated draft or package where appropriate. Run the same selection and package checks before child Restart. Save full commands and output under ignored `logs/test/<run-id>/`.
